events.times_in.text: Times are in the group's time zone:

events.no_teams.text: There are no teams you can add events for.

events.place_help.text: Pick one of the group's resources or enter a location, not both.

events.signup_help.text: The limit (1 to 999) and the deadline are optional. Leave them empty for none.

events.extra_coaches_help.text: The teams' coaches of the season are always coaches of the event. Pick any others here.

events.generated_edited.text: Generated from the weekly plan and changed by hand; regenerating the week keeps it.

events.warning.resource_capacity.text: {resource} allows {limit} teams at a time, but {teams} teams use it during this event.

events.delete_confirm.text: Delete this event? This cannot be undone. To keep it visible as cancelled, cancel it instead.

events.error.invalid_title.text: Enter a title of up to 128 characters.

events.error.invalid_end.text: The event must end after it starts and last at most 31 days.

events.error.time_skipped.text: This time does not exist in the group's time zone because the clocks move forward then. Pick another time.

events.error.invalid_teams.text: Pick teams of this group (at most 50).

events.error.place_required.text: Pick a resource or enter a location, not both.

events.error.invalid_resource.text: Pick one of the group's resources.

events.error.resource_archived.text: This resource is archived. Pick another one.

events.error.invalid_location.text: Enter a location of up to 255 characters.

events.error.invalid_max_participants.text: Enter a participant limit from 1 to 999, or leave it empty.

events.error.invalid_signup_deadline.text: The sign-up deadline must be before the event starts.

events.error.coach_role_missing.text: Extra coaches must hold the coach role in the group.
